P_calibration.quote: Items 4, 9–12, 19–20, 23, 33–38, and 42–45 are better framed as "unworkable or unconstitutional as drafted" arguments.
P_calibration.note: also: 'a joint resolution is just ordinary legislation subject to presentment, 7(a) adds nothing'

P_holdback.quote: publicly pointing to an exploitable loophole invites the Committee to close it with a second manager's amendment, while pointing to vagueness and unworkability tends to slow the bill. Legal and policy should decide which items go in the public-facing material versus the internal contingency memo.

P_grandfather_step.quote: Developers can begin as many large runs as they can stand up before signature, and nothing in the text requires those runs to be bona fide or complete.
